indications: Zolpidem tartrate tablets, USP are indicated for the short-term treatment of insomnia characterized by difficulties with sleep initiation. Zolpidem tartrate tablets, USP have been shown to decrease sleep latency for up to 35 days in controlled clinical studies. ( 1 )
contraindications: Adult dose: 10 mg once daily immediately before bedtime ( 2.1 ) Elderly/debilitated patients/hepatically impaired: 5 mg once daily immediately before bedtime ( 2.2 ) Downward dosage adjustment may be necessary when used with CNS depressants ( 2.3 ) Should not be taken with or immediately after a meal ( 2.4 )
warningsAndPrecautions:
Zolpidem tartrate 5 mg tablets, USP are red colored, capsule shaped tablets with the Torrent logo debossed on one side and ‘5 MG’ debossed on the other side and supplied as:
                  
                  
                  NDC
                  60760-515-30 BOTTLES OF 30
                  
                  60760-515-60 BOTTLES OF 60
                  
                  Store at 20°-25°C (68°-77°F); excursions permitted to 15° - 30°C (59°- 86°F) [see USP Controlled Room Temperature].
adverseReactions: Known hypersensitivity to zolpidem tartrate or to any of the inactive ingredients in the formulation ( 4.1 )
name: ZOLPIDEM TARTRATE
